Find the probability that a randomly chosen member of the club takes between 56 and 66 seconds
to swim 100 metres.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
13% of the members of the club take more than t minutes to swim 100 metres. Find the value
of t.

text: The times taken to swim 100 metres by members of a large swimming club have a normal distribution
with mean 62 seconds and standard deviation 5 seconds.

is denoted by the random variable X.

men on the committee. 
The 9 women and 5 men include a sister and brother.

parts.label: (b)

both be on the committee.

text: A committee of 6 people is to be chosen from 9 women and 5 men.
